scope: Read-only inventory of existing PR81 candidate -> LAPSPREP/WPS -> metgrid -> real chain, extended with isolated direct WPS source-operator replay for the preserved LAPS QC field. No full WPS, real.exe, or model run performed.

candidate_to_lapsprep.finding: The mapper validates exact pressure-coordinate matches and reverses level order when needed, then loops over identical i,j indices and copies candidate fields into the captured background arrays. It has no horizontal interpolation, coordinate lookup, or remapping weights. Geopotential is converted to height by division by gravity.
candidate_to_lapsprep.geometry_binding: Candidate and background must have matching shapes/metadata; this checks compatibility, not that either grid is native WRF mass/U/V geometry.

candidate_to_intermediate_writer.finding: Existing LAPSPREP writes WPS intermediate records from arrays as supplied. PR82 exact float32 readback establishes writer fidelity on 235x283 source-grid points, not a native-grid transfer operator.

metgrid.settings_finding: Same-time metgrid uses fg_name SOIT, SOIM, KLBG, LAPS, RCHA and operational table path; namelist does not specify explicit interp_option/weights.
metgrid.finding: The forward metgrid run yields a 234x282 mass grid and reports four offset comparisons only as exploratory; no source offset or exact cell mapping was selected. The retained run/settings prove the forward consumer path but do not provide a saved cell-weight table or verified inverse support map.

algorithm_sources.finding: Selects field interpolation methods from the operational METGRID.TBL and calls interp_to_latlon at target coordinates.
Default vertical_interp_option is linear_log_p; table parser stores per-field horizontal interpolation choices.
Parses ordered fallback/option strings such as nearest_neighbor, four_pt, sixteen_pt, average_4pt, weighted variants and search.

metgrid.horizontal_weights: For LAPS QC, actual v5 source header geometry and fresh direct interp_sequence replay now produce 36 nonzero REAL32 four_pt source-to-target links from the original 3x3 support, at 16 affected mass-grid targets and 18 exact pressure levels; all 288 direct source-only values match met_em QC bitwise. Links, coordinates, corner weights and inverse support are persisted in docs/evidence/pr91_science_sources_20261020/horizontal_replay/. Other fields retain separate active interpolation options, masks, priorities and staggering; their target-specific links remain uncomputed.
metgrid.vertical_note: WPS input carries pressure-level fields and metgrid output has pressure levels; the remaining pressure-to-native eta-level transformation occurs in real.exe. The retained real namelist/executable receipt does not contain per-native-level vertical coefficients or source influence membership.

qc_horizontal_replay.scope: QC horizontal component only; not proof that QC alone supplies final met_em or a native eta influence stencil.

real_vertical_transfer.finding: The retained real.exe consumes 21 metgrid pressure levels and produces 39 mass levels plus 40 staggered levels. The namelist and output identify the vertical transformation but no source-derived pressure-to-eta interpolation coefficients or source-cell influence weights were retained in the inspected evidence.

native_support_union_proposal.method: For a future source-bound derivation, compose the exact active horizontal coefficient rows from the retained WPS code for each relevant field/stagger and the exact real pressure-to-eta vertical coefficient rows; take the union of original pressure-grid support indices with nonzero composed coefficients for each native target. Honor missing/fill/terrain branches and preserve the original 162-cell mask.
native_support_union_proposal.current_status: QC source horizontal component is now bounded for 16 target columns × 18 pressure levels. Source-to-native union remains OPEN because real.exe pressure-to-hybrid influence is unreconstructed and other field-specific horizontal rows (TT/QV/U/V/geopotential, as applicable) are not mapped. Do not infer nearest cells, same-index native correspondence, or a full native footprint.

evidence_limitations: The actual forward metgrid source, active table, same-time namelist and output geometry are retained; this is stronger than having only executable settings.
The PR82 forward run readback preserves exploratory offset comparisons only; it selected no source offset and serialized no transfer-weight rows.
The candidate WPS exact readback is writer fidelity on the pressure grid, not a target-native influence map.

A fresh pinned-ifx isolated direct WPS interp_sequence replay was performed for QC; this is not a full process_domain/metgrid execution. The extracted 21 QC records, 288 target observations, replay programs, outputs, compiler profile, and source modules are archived. Other fields and native vertical composition remain open.
